#### Custom Spectator HUD for Team Fortress 2, created by [EssentialsTF](https://essentials.tf/).

> [!IMPORTANT]
> We kindly ask that you provide credit whenever the HUD is used in videos or live broadcasts outside of EssentialsTF.

## Installation
1. Download the latest versions of [EssentialsHUD](https://github.com/CriticalFlaw/essentialsHUD/archive/refs/heads/v1.zip) and [CastingEssentialsNext](https://github.com/drunderscore/CastingEssentialsNext/releases/latest).
2. Extract both downloads into your `tf/custom` folder.
3. Add `-insecure` to your Team Fortress 2 launch options.
4. Modify your preffered settings as needed in `tf/custom/essentialsHUD/cfg/casting_essentials.cfg` (See [sample](https://github.com/CriticalFlaw/essentialsHUD/blob/v1/cfg/casting_essentials.cfg)).
